_instructions.overview: This file contains all JSON-LD schema blocks for Anderson Junk Removal Pros. Each block is inserted into WordPress via WPCode (preferred) or Insert Headers and Footers plugin.
_instructions.tool: WPCode (free plugin) — WordPress Admin → Code Snippets → Add Snippet → Header & Footer → paste each block into the <head> section. Or use Insert Headers and Footers: WordPress Admin → Settings → Insert Headers and Footers → Scripts in Header.
_instructions.sitewide_block: LocalBusiness schema goes on every page — add it to the global header injection field.
_instructions.page_specific_blocks: FAQPage, Service, and BreadcrumbList schemas are page-specific. Use WPCode's 'Insert on specific pages' condition to target the correct URL for each.
_instructions.do_not_add: DO NOT add AggregateRating or Review schema — there are no real verified reviews yet. Fake review schema is a Google structured data policy violation with manual penalty risk.
_instructions.validate: After launch, validate each page at https://search.google.com/test/rich-results and https://validator.schema.org/

10_WPCode_implementation._tool: WPCode (recommended over Insert Headers and Footers for page-specific control)
steps: Install WPCode Free from WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → search 'WPCode'
Go to WordPress Admin → Code Snippets → Add Snippet
Paste the LocalBusiness schema (block 1 above, wrapped in <script type='application/ld+json'> tags) and set it to run on ALL pages
Create a separate snippet for each page-specific schema (FAQPage homepage, each Service schema, each BreadcrumbList)
For page-specific snippets: under 'Insert on specific pages', choose 'Page URL' → 'contains' → enter the page slug (e.g. '/furniture-removal-anderson/')
Validate with Google Rich Results Test: https://search.google.com/test/rich-results
validation_checklist: LocalBusiness appears sitewide — test on homepage and a service page
FAQPage appears on homepage only — confirm it does NOT appear on service pages
Service schema appears only on the matching service page
BreadcrumbList appears on all inner pages (not homepage)
Rich Results Test shows no errors (warnings are OK)
No AggregateRating or Review schema anywhere — double-check
